title: rosa coriifolia var. sepium
intro: Rosa coriifolia var. sepium, commonly known as Wild Roses, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and wounds, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rosa coriifolia var. sepium include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in wound healing and infection prevention. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
